title_zh: 医院门诊 & 承包商安全管理（一）
title_en: Day1: Hospital Outpatient & Contractor Safety Management (I)

vocab.example_en: Please take the patient to the emergency room right away.
vocab.example_zh: 请立刻把病人送到急诊室。

vocab.example_en: All contractors must complete pre-qualification before site access.
vocab.example_zh: 所有承包商入场前必须完成资格预审。

vocab.example_en: Hard hats are a mandatory requirement on all construction sites.
vocab.example_zh: 安全帽是所有施工现场的强制要求。
